name: Atmospheric Chemical Transport Modeling
description: The concept of model; Atmospheric chemistry model; chemical transport model (CTM); Simple models, one-box model, concept of lifetime, Mass balance equation; multi-box model; Puff model; Basics of atmospheric structure, physics, and dynamics; Chemical processes in the atmosphere; The continuity equation for chemical species; Eulerian form, derivation, discretization; Lagrangian form; Vertical coordinates; Numerical frameworks for Eulerian models; Model grids; Operator splitting; Numerical methods for chemical systems and advection; Surface fluxes, emissions, deposition; Atmospheric observations and model evaluations; Inverse modeling of atmospheric chemistry; Global and regional CTMs; Applications: GEOS-Chem and WRF-Chem CTMs.
